research_mode: official ONS and Home Office sources only; current YE March 2026 offence composition, coverage, trend, data-quality and outcome-timing controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Theft from the person
verified_claims: police recorded theft from the person decreased 20% to 121,161
the series had increased since year ending March 2021
limitations: recorded counts depend on reporting and classification

sources.name: Shoplifting reporting limitation
verified_claims: shoplifting reporting rates are known to be very low
police encourage reporting and submission of supporting evidence such as CCTV
limitations: recorded shoplifting is not a complete measure of incidents

sources.name: CSEW criminal damage
verified_claims: CSEW estimated around 646,000 criminal damage incidents
there was no statistically significant annual change

sources.name: Criminal damage decade comparison
verified_claims: CSEW criminal damage was 47% lower than the year ending March 2016 estimate of 1.2 million
limitations: the comparison applies to covered household crime

sources.name: Criminal damage peak comparison
verified_claims: CSEW criminal damage was 81% below the year ending December 1995 peak of 3.4 million
limitations: survey-period and design metadata must be retained

sources.name: Recorded criminal damage
verified_claims: police recorded 433,251 criminal damage offences
this was a 2% annual fall
limitations: recording practice affects the administrative series

sources.name: Fraud since earliest comparable year
verified_claims: CSEW fraud incidents were 32% higher than the earliest comparable year ending March 2017 estimate of around 3.4 million
limitations: fraud estimates are not available before the comparable 2017 series

sources.name: Computer misuse incidents
verified_claims: CSEW estimated 798,000 computer misuse incidents
there was no statistically significant annual change
limitations: police recorded computer misuse was not presented during the system transition

sources.name: Computer misuse long-term comparison
verified_claims: CSEW computer misuse was around 55% lower than the year ending March 2017 estimate of around 1.8 million
limitations: the comparison begins with the earliest comparable year

sources.name: Business cybercrime prevalence
verified_claims: 19% of businesses reported at least one cybercrime in the Cyber Security Breaches Survey 2025 to 2026
limitations: the business survey is separate from household CSEW and police records

sources.name: Charity cybercrime prevalence
verified_claims: 14% of charities reported at least one cybercrime in the Cyber Security Breaches Survey 2025 to 2026
limitations: the charity survey population differs from household and police datasets

sources.name: ASB supporting methodology schedule
verified_claims: ONS scheduled a supporting anti-social-behaviour methodology article for 25 August 2026
limitations: the scheduled article was future-dated at the bulletin release and should be checked when published

sources.name: NDQIS availability
verified_claims: the National Data Quality Improvement Service was available to 42 police forces
limitations: availability does not guarantee identical adoption or usage

sources.name: NDQIS four-collection scope
verified_claims: NDQIS flags offences involving knives, domestic abuse, child sexual abuse and online crime across four police collections
limitations: flagging supports consistency but does not create parcel-level observations

sources.name: Report Fraud source integration
verified_claims: Report Fraud brings together public-facing reports with fraud reports from Cifas and UK Finance
limitations: the integrated system creates a break from legacy Action Fraud processing
